verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API, OAuth 2.0 authentication, a downloadable OpenAPI corpus and Zoho MCP, but no official language SDKs or client libraries for Zoho Books. The OpenAPI document and raw REST endpoints are developer building blocks from which an SDK could be generated, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit. Official SDKs are a fair axis for a SaaS accounting API, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
